summary: Provision siloed experiment workspace template with approval webhook, ephemeral Slack channel policy, and seeded Confluence docs
description:
Issue summary:
Request to create a reusable, tenant-scoped "experiment workspace" template that provisions three coordinated artifacts: a Jira project (sandbox-type, restricted permissions), a Confluence space pre-seeded with an evaluation checklist and data handling guidance, and an ephemeral Slack channel with an approval join flow (approval webhook + just-in-time role assignment).

Background / motivation:
Several research and model-eval teams want self-service sandboxes that are: isolated from product infra, timebound (ephemeral), have a minimal audit trail for compliance, and include a starter doc/checklist so experiments follow tagging/data handling norms. Current requests are ad-hoc and manually fulfilled by platform ops. We want a templated, automatable flow to reduce friction and enforce guardrails.

Requirements / acceptance criteria:
- A Jira project template that creates a project with Issue Security scheme set to "sandbox-private" and a project role mapping that only allows the requesting owner + reviewer group to view.
- A Confluence space scaffolded from a seeded template containing: experiment README, data classification checklist, evaluation metrics template, and a one-click link back to the Jira project.
- A Slack channel created with naming convention r&d-{owner}-{short-id}, private by default, with an approval flow via an HTTP webhook to the support-automation service. Approvers: repository of reviewers in the "research-reviewers" group.
- Ephemeral lifecycle: channel and Jira issues should be auto-archived after 30 days of inactivity; Confluence space should be flagged for archival after 90 days with export of space attachments to S3.
- Auditability: on creation and archival, the workflow must write an entry to the centralized audit log (Confluence page link + internal runbook event + S3 export path).
- Minimal service account scope: the automation should use a scoped service account with least privilege needed and the permissions documented in the ticket.
- A one-click "reprovision" button in the Confluence seed that re-opens the provisioning request with previous parameters.

Non-functional requirements:
- Provisioning must complete end-to-end in < 3 minutes for standard template requests.
- RBAC checks and approval webhook must have retries/backoff and clear error messages for the user in Slack.

Rollout plan / steps to delivery:
1) Create Jira project template and project role mappings in staging.
2) Develop Confluence seed template in staging space: /spaces/RSB/Experiment-Seed (draft).
3) Implement Slack approval webhook endpoint in support-automation repo with basic unit tests and a lightweight retry policy.
4) Wire up provisioning orchestration as a GitHub Actions workflow that calls platform admin APIs and records events to audit S3.
5) Smoke test with platform-pod (2 owners) and security reviewer group.
6) Enable in prod behind a feature flag; monitor provisioning latency and error rate for one week before wide enablement.

Rollback / mitigation:
- If audit exports fail, fail the provisioning and notify the requestor + platform-ops channel for manual review.

Dependencies and links:
- Related runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Provisioning+Runbook
- Proposed GH work: https://github.com/redwood-inference/support-automation/pulls/458 (WIP)
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - this is a provisioning request rather than a bug. See rollout plan for test steps.
acceptance_criteria: Jira template created, Confluence seed present, Slack approval webhook implemented, end-to-end provisioning completes in <3m, and audit exports are generated on create/archival.
work_notes: Platform-ops to own orchestration; security will own audit export contract and retention. Requesting team: Model Eval. Please confirm reviewer group membership and desired inactivity TTL if different from defaults.

DevInfra (engineering) - 2026-03-03: We've started a WIP PR for the webhook handler (support-automation/pull/458). Question: should the Slack approval include an optional justification field or be one-click approve/deny? One-click reduces friction but loses context.
Priya Nair - 2026-03-03: Include a small 'purpose' text field in the request. Makes post-hoc audits easier.

Liam Chen - 2026-03-04: Implemented purpose field in the request model, pushed initial Confluence seed draft to staging space. Next: hook up project role template and test provisioning flow with platform-pod.
Security (Maya Patel) - 2026-03-04: Confirmed vault flow for SA; we'll provide policy snippets. Also requested that any exported attachments be scanned for secrets before being copied to S3.
